transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support. My name is Sophie. How may I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good morning Sophie. My name is Dr. Bilal Al-Mansoor. I am calling from my home study in Cambridge. I am experiencing a very specific issue where our home broadband is blocking access to a legitimate medical research portal.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning Dr. Bilal. I will be very happy to look into your broadband filtering settings for you. Before we inspect your connection, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, of course. My address is 27 Wilberforce Road, Cambridge, CB3 0EQ, and my four-digit account security PIN is 5819.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you very much Dr. Bilal, that successfully verifies your account. What error or notification appears when you attempt to navigate to the medical research portal?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Whenever I click on the repository link, the browser redirects immediately to an S-Net branded warning screen that says 'Access Restricted by Content Shield' under the restricted content category.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you provide the exact website domain and URL of the portal you are trying to reach, Dr. Bilal?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the primary domain is oncology-trials.nihr.ac.uk, which hosts clinical trial telemetry datasets for the National Institute for Health and Care Research.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Does this block happen across all computers and tablets in your home, or only on your work laptop?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It happens across all devices connected to the home Wi-Fi, including my university laptop, my desktop, and my smartphone when connected to Wi-Fi.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And when you disconnect your smartphone from Wi-Fi and use cellular mobile data, does the site open normally?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, on mobile 5G data it loads instantly without any warning. So it is definitely our S-Net home broadband line blocking it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So if I understand correctly, Dr. Bilal, your home connection has our network-level Content Shield active, and its automated classification engine has mistakenly flagged the NIHR oncology research portal as restricted adult material, blocking all household devices from accessing it, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is precisely the problem, Sophie. It appears to be an automated false-positive categorization.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I open your broadband profile in our DNS filtering management console and review your Content Shield category rules.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Certainly, I will wait.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Dr. Bilal. I have accessed your account's Content Shield ledger. Your line is currently set to the 'Standard Family' protection profile, which filters adult content, gambling, and unclassified domains.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I see. We have young teenage children in the house, so we definitely want to keep parental controls active for general browsing.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That makes complete sense. We do not need to disable Content Shield altogether; we can create a permanent domain whitelisting exception specifically for the medical portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I must emphasize that I have a strict 5 PM deadline today to submit the Lancet oncology clinical trial telemetry dataset. If I cannot access the portal to verify patient records, the entire research paper submission will be delayed by six months! It is causing me considerable anxiety!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the critical nature of this oncology research submission, Dr. Bilal, and the anxiety with that 5 PM deadline; please rest assured, we will get Content Shield whitelisting configured and propagating right now so you can meet your deadline.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Sophie, I truly appreciate your understanding of how important this is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the exact domain string. Before I commit the domain bypass rule in Content Shield, could you confirm the spelling of the domain again, was that oncology-trials.nihr.ac.uk?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is correct: oncology hyphen trials dot nihr dot ac dot uk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are there any secondary CDN or authentication subdomains associated with the portal, such as auth.nihr.ac.uk or cdn.nihr.ac.uk?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the single sign-on authentication runs through login.nihr.ac.uk. It would be wise to whitelist that as well so login tokens aren't blocked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is an excellent point. I will add a wildcard exception for asterisk dot nihr dot ac dot uk, which covers the primary portal, the authentication server, and any telemetry endpoints.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is a brilliant idea, that will prevent any future subdomains from being caught.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: One moment while I inject this wildcard bypass rule directly into the authoritative DNS resolver tables for your broadband circuit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Certainly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Dr. Bilal. The rule has been successfully written to our DNS resolvers: wildcard allow for dot nihr dot ac dot uk on your line profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does it take for the router and our computers to pick up the updated DNS table?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our network DNS servers update within sixty seconds. To ensure your computer bypasses any locally cached DNS records, we should flush the local DNS cache or restart the browser.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I can flush the DNS cache in Terminal on my laptop right now. Running dscacheutil flushcache now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Once you have cleared the local resolver cache, please open a fresh browser window and navigate to the portal URL.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Navigating to oncology-trials.nihr.ac.uk now... It is loading... Yes! The secure NIHR medical portal landing page has appeared with the full login prompt!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is wonderful! Please go ahead and log into your research dashboard to verify that authentication and telemetry data load without restriction.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Entering my smartcard credentials now... The dashboard has loaded completely! All clinical trial cohorts and patient telemetry charts are showing properly!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent news, Dr. Bilal. And just to confirm, other general adult and restricted content categories remain securely blocked for the rest of your household.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I just verified on another tab that parental filtering is still actively protecting the network. That is the ideal solution.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will also submit a domain recategorization request to our Content Shield database team so that nihr dot ac dot uk is permanently reclassified under Education and Health for all UK customers.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will help many other medical researchers and academic colleagues who use S-Net across the country. Thank you Sophie.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It is my absolute pleasure, Dr. Bilal. We have whitelisted the domain, confirmed portal access, and verified that your research submission can proceed on schedule.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, everything is working flawlessly now. I can proceed with the Lancet submission without any delay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your broadband service, speed, or home network settings that I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that was my only concern and it has been resolved perfectly. Thank you Sophie.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome, Dr. Bilal. I wish you the very best of luck with your research paper publication.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you kindly, Sophie. Have a wonderful day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net broadband technical support, Dr. Bilal. Have a productive afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You too, Sophie. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Take care and goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our customer support team is always available should you ever need assistance with academic research portals.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is wonderful to know.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have a restful evening once your paper is submitted.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I certainly will, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye, Dr. Bilal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Sophie.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Dr. Bilal. Goodbye.
